title: Best Electric Toothbrushes UK
short: Sonic and rotary electric toothbrushes compared by cleaning, battery life and features.
intro: An electric toothbrush is one of the simplest ways to improve your brushing. This guide compares sonic and rotary models from independent UK testing, from budget picks to high-end brushes with pressure sensors and apps.

guide.a: Sonic brushes vibrate the bristles at high speed, while rotary brushes use a small round head that spins or oscillates. Both can clean well when used properly, so choose the feel you prefer.

guide.q: Do I need a pressure sensor?
guide.a: A pressure sensor warns you when you press too hard, which can help protect gums and enamel. It is useful if you tend to scrub, but not essential.

guide.q: How often should I change the brush head?
guide.a: Manufacturers commonly recommend replacing the head about every three months, or sooner if the bristles look worn.

guide.q: Are smart features worth paying for?
guide.a: Apps and tracking can help build good habits, but the core job is the same. If you brush well without prompts, a simpler model is often better value.
